initial_condition: Two distinguishable lightweight rigid objects and their specified stable trays are visible and identified.
goal: Place object A on tray A and object B on tray B, verifying both final placements.
constraints: RGB-only object judgment; no calibration, simulator object state or historical motion targets.
One bounded action proposal per observation cycle; preserve execution limits and uncertainty latches.
Model visual claims and independently reviewed outcomes must be reported separately.
Freeze both object-to-tray assignments before moving either object.
The second placement must not disturb the first; final observation verifies both goals together.

steps.goal: Identify the specified objects, initial state and available RGB views; freeze the task variant.
Approach object A along a visually clear route.
Align the open fingers with a feasible grasp on object A.
Grasp object A and verify retention after separation from its support.
Carry object A toward tray A while verifying retention.
Visually align object A over tray A.
Establish support of object A on tray A without pressing.
Release the supported object A and withdraw the empty gripper.
Verify object A remains on tray A in separated views after gripper withdrawal.
Approach object B along a visually clear route.
Align the open fingers with a feasible grasp on object B.
Grasp object B and verify retention after separation from its support.
Carry object B toward tray B while verifying retention.
Visually align object B over tray B.
Establish support of object B on tray B without pressing.
Release the supported object B and withdraw the empty gripper.
Verify object B remains on tray B in separated views after gripper withdrawal.
Verify both objects remain independently supported on their assigned trays.
